confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, because Hampi's guesthouse prices vary widely by season, location and registration status. The estimate assumes a July monsoon (low-season) window, so room rates may run lower than the October-February peak. Beer is a bottled-beer proxy, since draft is uncommon locally. Cocktail was set at about 1.8x beer and wine at about 2.5x beer because direct local knowledge of those prices is weak. Hostel and hotel tiers are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional knowledge of budget-to-mid-range backpacker and heritage-tourism towns in Karnataka and southern India, such as Gokarna and other small tourist towns near major heritage sites, with prices adjusted for Hampi's riverside guesthouse market. No specific current listings were consulted.
